name: Bhutan

flag.description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with a yellow upper triangle and an orange lower triangle, and a white dragon holding jewels in its claws lying along the dividing line.
flag.symbolism: Yellow represents the secular authority of the king and orange the Buddhist spiritual tradition; the white dragon (Druk) stands for purity and the jewels for the wealth and security of the nation.

hook: Bhutan flies a white thunder dragon on a yellow-and-orange diagonal; its own name for itself, Druk Yul, means "Land of the Thunder Dragon".
trivia: Bhutan is known for measuring Gross National Happiness as a guide to government policy.
More than two-thirds of the country is forested, and Bhutan absorbs more carbon dioxide than it emits.
